narrative.overview: Cloudberry is drawn as the faceplate of a small hardware radio in the Teenage Engineering / Nothing tradition: aluminium-grey chassis, one raised deck, ruled lists, one hot orange. The world lends type, palette, density and the physical key/readout move, never costume.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange marks what is live, yours, or the next action. Otherwise graphite.

rules.name: The Labelled Lamp Rule
rules.body: A lamp never carries meaning alone; it sits beside a word.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono labels name a module or control; the label is the heading, never an eyebrow above one.

rules.name: The Lip Not Drop Rule
rules.body: Raised means a 1–2px lower lip in the key's own darker tone; no offset block shadows or glows.

dos: Do keep orange to live/yours/next-action elements.
Do set numbers in mono with tabular figures.
Do separate modules with 1px rules and tone.
Do keep motion 50–360ms with no overshoot.
donts: Don't bring back stickers, die-cuts, offset drops, tilts, bog green, cream or Fredoka.
Don't use emoji or a stock icon library.
